column1: # The inversion breakpoints of this project (SPEC decision 70). Coordinates are in the reference Mzebra_GT3_NCBI (GT3a; chromosome accessions NC_135166 + LG number).
# bp1_* and bp2_* are the start and end of the interval that contains the left and the right breakpoint. In a tandem (double) inversion the right breakpoint of the first part
# is the left breakpoint of the second (11a/11b, 20a/20b): the two rows carry the identical interval.
# Source of every `published` row: Kumar et al. 2025, eLife (doi 10.7554/eLife.104923), Supplementary File 4, copied by hand on 2026-11-11. Kumar et al. do not cover LG5:
# its row is this pipeline's own call (`inversion_breakpoints`: LatrZW and MezeOBm; SPEC decisions 71 and 73). reference_state: Kumar et al. report
# that the reference haplotype of GT3a is the ancestral (non-inverted) state for all six of their inversions.

column11: not in Kumar et al.; the high-confidence consensus row of run 20261110-183552_aa6580ae (LatrZW:A, MezeOBm:A; left_min to left_max, right_min to right_max), intervals 86 bp and 9 bp wide, 7.07 Mb; Behrens et al. 2025 give about 7 Mb (6.89 Mb in UMD2a); W / orange-blotch inversion
our own four-assembly call put the left breakpoint 291 kb to the left (14,621,505): see comparison_kumar_vs_pipeline_20261110.tsv
tandem with 11b: the right breakpoint of 11a is the left breakpoint of 11b
tandem with 20b; 20a formed first; the four Rhamphochromis carry 20a only
tandem with 20a; these intervals give 3.47 to 3.57 Mb, the text of Kumar et al. says 4.1 Mb
